title: STOP RE-ROLLING THE WHOLE IMAGE
subtitle: Deterministic infographics with XYZ Layout Engine
abstract: Generative image models can make a great-looking infographic. Fixing one label or moving one callout means regenerating the whole thing and hoping nothing else changes.
split: XYZ Layout Engine splits the work: AI handles art direction, copy and isolated cutout illustrations; a deterministic renderer owns exact geometry, typography and export.
dogfood: Every slide in this deck is a JSON fixture rendered by the engine's own renderer in both backends, Satori + resvg and headless Chromium. No slide is an image-model output.
